_comment_: REQUIRED fields are marked. Everything else is optional — script applies sensible defaults.
Address fields are required because we geocode them via Mapbox if lat/lng is missing.
interest_rate is in PERCENT format (2.875 not 0.02875).
unpaid_balance is in dollars. If you don't know it, a 15-20% guess below the asking price is a reasonable proxy.
listings.description: Sun-drenched single-story in Central Phoenix with a remodeled kitchen and shaded backyard.
listings._notes_for_seed_script_: The seed script will compute monthly_payment from rate + balance + remaining term, and insert a row into both `listings` and `verifications` (tier='seller-verified'). Skip `assumable_flags` for manual listings — Cotality enrichment will populate it later.
